cases.name: exact rows first, each list in database then tree order

cases.name: the same entry id in two databases gives two rows
locked databases are counted and take no part
no unlocked database is an error
no database at all is an error
an unlocked database with AutoFill off is not an error
no match is an empty list
an invalid origin is refused before anything else
an invalid origin is refused even with every database locked
at most 50 rows: exact rows past 50 are dropped
at most 50 rows: possible rows fill what exact rows leave
at most 50 rows: exact rows found after 50 possible ones still come first

cases.note: a character is a user-perceived character: e + U+0301, a flag pair and a ZWJ family each count as one
